sources.description:
William Liao Portrait

William Liao appears in a close-up promotional portrait, showcasing his tousled dark hair, clear complexion, and neutral expression. He wears a white shirt layered under a casual jacket against a plain light gray background.

Liao is a Taiwanese actor and writer known for roles in My Little Princess, Small & Mighty, One Night in Taipei, Brown Sugar Macchiato, Assassin Legend, Someone Like You, The Legend of Brown Sugar Chivalries, and The Stand Up. This image corresponds to his profile on The Movie Database.

sources.title: William Liao Yi-Yin (廖亦崟, 廖威廉) :: Everything about cinema of Hong Kong, China and Taiwan
sources.description:
William Liao Yi-Yin Portrait

William Liao Yi-Yin, also known by his Chinese names 廖亦崟 and 廖威廉, appears in a studio portrait wearing a white pinstriped vest layered over a black V-neck shirt. His dark hair is styled with volume, and he stands against a neutral gray backdrop that emphasizes his relaxed yet refined appearance.

Born on October 7, 1985, William Liao has been active in Hong Kong cinema from 1997 through 2022, appearing in 19 films and performing as part of the pop group Lollipop F. This image captures his approachable demeanor and fashion-forward style, reflecting his dual career as an actor and entertainer.

sources.description:
William’s Comeback Portrait

William stands against a minimalist backdrop, wearing a tailored black blazer left open to reveal his chest and a distinctive pendant necklace. His hair is styled neatly, and his gaze is steady, conveying both confidence and calm.

Following his involvement in the military draft evasion scandal earlier this year, William reunited with his former boy band Lollipop F at the Golden Bell Awards on October 17. There, he received the Reality Program Host Award and publicly thanked his family, marking a significant step in his return to the entertainment industry.

William Speaks at Celebrity Pickleball Charity Event

William (廖亦崟) of the Taiwanese boy band Lollipop appeared at the First Star Motion Cup – Celebrity Pickleball Charity Tournament in Taipei on November 22, 2025. Wearing a navy T‑shirt branded “Quickhand,” he took the opportunity to address recent controversies surrounding his bandmates. When asked about the group’s troubles, he admitted, “Lollipop has had a lot going on lately, sorry everyone, you’ve worked hard!” and offered support to those facing legal proceedings.
